posts.content:
AI governance legitimacy is not a byproduct of technical progress—it's the precondition for effective coordination across labs, operators, and jurisdictions.

#AIGovernance #InstitutionalAI

EU AI Act high-risk requirements take full effect August 2026. This shifts governance from guidance to enforcement.

#AIRegulation #AIPolicy

NIST AI RMF provides the backbone, ISO 42001 offers certification paths. Together they form a layered governance model.

#AISafety #AITransparency
